characters.name: 面馆老板
characters.design: Middle-aged Chinese man with a warm, approachable expression, wearing a simple white cotton T-shirt and a light blue apron dusted with flour. Short black hair, slightly tanned skin, calloused hands from years of kneading dough. Front-facing half-body view, natural morning light highlighting his gentle smile.

characters.name: 首位顾客
characters.design: Young office worker in a neat light gray jacket, holding a reusable coffee cup, with a relaxed, expectant expression. Light brown short hair, fair skin, standing by the shop window. Half-body side view, soft morning backlight outlining his silhouette.

props.name: 揉面面团
props.design: Freshly kneaded smooth white wheat dough, dusted with a thin layer of white flour, resting on a dark wooden kneading board. Soft natural light highlighting the soft texture of the dough, close-up view to show the fine flour particles.

props.name: 热汤面
props.design: Steaming bowl of clear broth wheat noodles, topped with a few green scallions and a slice of braised egg, in a simple white ceramic bowl. Wispy hot steam rising from the surface, warm golden light catching the steam, close-up view to emphasize the appetizing look.

scenes.name: 面馆后厨
scenes.design: Small, cozy traditional Chinese noodle shop kitchen, with a dark wooden kneading board, a large stainless steel boiling pot on a gas stove, and shelves holding simple cooking ingredients. Soft diffused morning sunlight seeping through the frosted kitchen window, dust motes dancing in the light, warm hazy atmosphere, medium-wide view.

scenes.name: 面馆窗边
scenes.design: Narrow spot by the noodle shop front window, with a small wooden stool and a simple small table, morning sunlight streaming through the glass, faint view of the quiet street outside. Warm, cozy morning vibe, medium shot to show the space where the customer waits.
